div.head: II As 23
div.ab: [Be ðon ðe ordales weddigaþ.] [Ld] Gif hwa ordales weddige, ðonne cume he þrim nihtum ær to þam mæssepreoste þe hit halgian scyle, ond fede hine sylfne mid hlafe ⁊ mid wætre ⁊ sealte ⁊ wyrtum, ær he togan scyle, ⁊ gestonde him mæssan þæra þreora daga ælcne, ⁊ offrige to ⁊ gá to husle ðy dæge þe he to ðam ordale gan scyle, swerige ðonne þone að þæt he sy mid folcryhte unscyldig ðære tihtlan, ær he to þam ordale gá.

If anyone engages to undergo an ordeal, he shall come three days before the mass-priest who is to consecrate it, and he shall feed himself on bread and water and salt and herbs before he proceeds thither, and he shall attend mass on each of the three days. And on the day he has to go to the ordeal, he shall make an offering and attend communion; and then before he goes to the ordeal, he shall swear an oath that according to the public law he is innocent of the accusation.

Be ðon ðe ordales weddigaþ. Gif hwa ordales weddige, ðonne cume he ðrim nihtum ær to ðam mæssepreoste ðe hit halgian scyle, ⁊ fede hine sylfne mid hlafe ⁊ sealte ⁊ wætere ⁊ wyrtum, ær he togán scyle, ⁊ gestande his mæssan ðæra ðreora dage ylce, ⁊ geoffrige to ⁊ ga to husle ðy dæge ðe he to ðæm ordale gán scyle, swyrige ðone aþ, þæt he se mid folcrihte unscyldig ðære tyhtelan, ær ðe he to ðæm ordale gá.
